meta.note: One row per US obligation. 'verified' means the value was read from the cited official page in this session.

forms.triggers: US person with a financial interest in, or signature authority over, any foreign financial account, where the aggregate value of all such accounts exceeded USD 10,000 at ANY time during the calendar year
forms.threshold: USD 10,000 aggregate, at any point in the year
forms.due: April 15 following the calendar year; automatic extension to October 15, no request needed
forms.filed_where: FinCEN BSA E-Filing System — NOT filed with your tax return
forms.penalty: Non-willful: up to USD 16,536 per violation. Willful: up to USD 165,353 per violation (both inflation-adjusted, for penalties assessed on or after 2025-01-17)
forms.records: Keep account name, number, bank name and address, account type and maximum value for 5 years from the FBAR due date
forms.note: A Chinese bank account holding RMB is a foreign financial account. Whether it produced taxable income is irrelevant to the FBAR test.

forms.form: Form 8938 (Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets)
forms.triggers: Specified individual (e.g. US citizen) with an interest in specified foreign financial assets above the threshold, AND required to file an income tax return
forms.threshold: Unmarried living in the US: USD 50,000 year-end / USD 75,000 any time. MFJ in the US: 100,000 / 150,000. Living abroad single: 200,000 / 300,000. Living abroad joint: 400,000 / 600,000
forms.due: Attached to your annual income tax return
forms.penalty: USD 10,000; plus up to USD 50,000 more if the failure continues after IRS notice (USD 10,000 per 30-day period after 90 days)
forms.note: If you are not required to file a return, you do not file Form 8938 — even above the threshold. Reasonable cause is a defence under §6038D(g).

forms.form: Form 3520, Part IV (large foreign gifts / bequests)
forms.triggers: US person receiving gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien individual or foreign estate above the reporting threshold — e.g. a Chinese relative remitting money to you
forms.threshold: UNVERIFIED — commonly stated as USD 100,000 aggregate per year; the threshold paragraph was not read from the IRS page in this session
forms.due: April 15, or October 15 with an extension
forms.filed_where: Mailed to the IRS separately; not attached to the return
forms.penalty: UNVERIFIED — the §6039F 5%-per-month / 25%-of-gift rule is widely cited but was not read from an official page in this session
forms.note: FLAGGED. Included because it is the correct form for the 'relative sends me money' variant, which is the most commonly suggested workaround.

forms.triggers: US person who paid or accrued foreign income tax on foreign-source income
forms.note: FLAGGED — the mechanism is certain in outline (IIT Law Art.7 provides the mirror-image Chinese credit for foreign tax paid), but the specific US limitation rules were not retrieved in this session. No credit amount is asserted anywhere in this project.

forms.form: Form 105 (Report of International Transportation of Currency or Monetary Instruments)
forms.triggers: Physically transporting more than the threshold in currency or monetary instruments into or out of the United States
forms.note: FLAGGED — the official FinCEN page returned HTTP 404 during this session, so the threshold is not used as a table value.

forms.form: Schedule B, Part III (Foreign Accounts and Trusts)
forms.triggers: Any US person with a foreign financial account, answering the Part III questions
forms.threshold: No threshold — the questions are yes/no
forms.penalty: Accuracy-related penalties may follow an incorrect answer
forms.note: FLAGGED — not retrieved in this session. Listed so the compliance picture is not artificially truncated.

sequence_advice: Fix reporting first, conversion second. The penalty regime in K9-K11 is an order of magnitude larger than any FX spread, and it accrues every year you hold the account.

If prior years were missed and the conduct was not willful, the Streamlined Filing Compliance Procedures are the intended route (S25): a certification of non-willful conduct, amended or delinquent returns, and no closing agreement. It is unavailable if you are already under civil examination or criminal investigation.
Never 'quiet disclose' by filing a bare amended return and hoping — the IRS states that previously assessed penalties are not abated by later joining the streamlined procedures.
Then, and only then, choose the conversion route based on the SOURCE of the funds.
